title: 第25章 秦清第26章 你什么时候回来的
lines: “警察来了！”
“什么？”红裙女子大吃一惊，急忙跑到窗户前，只见十多辆警车停在夜总会外面，数十名全副武装的警察将整栋楼都给包围了起来。
“糟了！”
看到她满脸焦急的样子，江来笑着道：“既然你有胆量杀人，难道还怕警察？”
红裙女子岂会听不出他话语中的揶揄，忍不住瞪了他一眼，独自在客房中来回踱步，思索着对策，“刘浩云是夜总会的老板，警察突袭检查，肯定会找他谈话，万一他们找到这里来，怎么办……怎么办？”
自言自语中，她突然注意到，江来依靠着窗台，嘴里叼着一支香烟，正在那吞云吐雾，一副满不在乎的表情，似乎感觉不到即将到来的危机。
“喂！”她忍不住叫道：“你就不怕警察把你抓去？”
“我？”江来指着自己的鼻子，失笑道：“我为什么要怕，人又不是我杀的。”
“那你还在这干什么？”
“等你求我。”
红裙女子一怔，不解的问道：“你什么意思？”
“我可以帮你洗脱罪名，但前提是你得求我，这个世界上没有免费的午餐，我总不能无缘无故的帮你。”看着陷入沉思和犹豫中的红裙女子，江来吐出一口烟雾，道：“美女，你可要抓紧时间，万一警察找上来，就算我想帮你也没用。”
“好！”红裙女子轻咬着银牙，点点头道：“我恳求你的帮忙，如果我能安全离开，只要不是太过分的要求，我都可以答应你。”
“爽快！”江来笑着打了个响指，道：“现在，我让你做什么，你就做什么。第一件事，先脱衣服！”
不多时，红裙女子用浴袍裹着婀娜多姿的身材，抖了抖湿漉漉的长发，俏脸微红，款步走到客房门口，将房门打开一套缝隙。
看她探头出来，守在门外的几名彪悍男子忍不住睁大眼睛，贪婪的窥视着浴袍里面的春光。
“嘿嘿！美女，我们老大呢，你们……还没完事？”
红裙女子轻咬着薄唇，细声细气道：“刘先生让你们去请徐队过来，就说有事找他商量。”
“没问题，我马上去。”
一名男子笑眯眯的问道：“美女，能不能留个电话，咱们以后多联系一下。”
听到这话，红裙女子脸色一冷，从嘴里吐出一个‘滚’字，然后‘砰’的一声，重重的将房门关上。
“你小子，胆儿可真肥，老大的女人你都敢动心思，就不怕老大把你给阉了？”旁边的同伴打趣道。
“切！有什么好怕的，老大也是随便玩玩，难不成还真娶她当老婆？”
“那可说不定，像这种极品女人，难保老大不会动心，你以后说话还是小心点。”
没过多久，徐青尾随着刘浩云的手下匆匆走来，嘴里念叨道：“不就是警察找上门来了吗，例行检查而已，有什么好大惊小怪的，这种小事还要找我商量。”
咚咚咚！
“老大，徐队来了。”
content_en:
"The police are coming!"
"What?" The woman in the red dress was shocked and hurried to the window. She saw more than a dozen police cars parked outside the nightclub, and dozens of heavily armed police officers surrounded the entire building.
"Oops!"
Seeing the anxious look on her face, Jiang Lai smiled and said, "Since you have the guts to kill people, are you still afraid of the police?"
Could it be that the woman in the red dress couldn't hear the teasing in his words? She couldn't help but glare at him, pacing back and forth in the guest room alone, thinking about countermeasures, "Liu Haoyun is the owner of the nightclub. The police will conduct a surprise inspection and will definitely talk to him. What if they find here... what should I do?"
While talking to herself, she suddenly noticed that Jiang Lai was leaning on the window sill, smoking a cigarette with a cigarette in his mouth, with an indifferent expression, as if he could not feel the coming crisis.
"Hey!" she couldn't help shouting: "Aren't you afraid that the police will arrest you?"
"Me?" Jiang Lai pointed at his nose and said with a smile, "Why should I be afraid? I didn't kill the person."
"Then what are you still doing here?"
"Wait until you beg me."
The woman in the red dress was startled and asked in confusion: "What do you mean?"
"I can help you clear your name, but only if you beg me. There is no free lunch in this world. I can't help you for no reason." Looking at the woman in the red dress who was deep in thought and hesitation, Jiang Lai exhaled a puff of smoke and said: "Beauty, you have to hurry up. If the police come, it will be useless even if I want to help you."
"Okay!" The woman in the red dress bit her silver teeth and nodded: "I beg for your help. If I can leave safely, I can agree to your request as long as it is not too much."
"Exciting!" Jiang Lai smiled and snapped his fingers and said, "Now, do whatever I ask you to do. The first thing is to take off your clothes!"
…
Not long after, the woman in the red dress wrapped her graceful figure in a bathrobe, shook her wet long hair, her pretty face was slightly red, she walked to the door of the guest room, and opened the door a few cracks.
Seeing her sticking her head out, the tough men guarding the door couldn't help but open their eyes wide and greedily peeked at the spring light inside the bathrobe.
"Hehe! Beauty, where's our boss? Are you... not done yet?"
The woman in the red dress bit her thin lips lightly and said in a low voice: "Mr. Liu asked you to invite Captain Xu to come over. Just say you have something to discuss with him."
"No problem, I'll go right away."
A man asked with a smile: "Beauty, can you leave your phone number so that we can contact you more in the future?"
Hearing this, the woman in the red dress turned cold, uttered the word 'get out' from her mouth, and then slammed the door with a 'bang'.
"You boy, you are so courageous. If you dare to flirt with the boss's woman, aren't you afraid that the boss will castrate you?" the companion next to him joked.
"Tch! What's there to be afraid of? The boss is just playing around, is it possible that he will really marry her as his wife?"
"That's possible. There's no guarantee that the boss won't be tempted by such a top-notch woman. You'd better be careful what you say in the future."
Not long after, Xu Qing followed Liu Haoyun's men in a hurry and muttered: "Isn't it just the police who came to the door? It's just a routine inspection. There's nothing to make a fuss about. You have to discuss such a trivial matter with me."
Boom, boom, boom!
"Boss, Captain Xu is here."
title_en: Chapter 25 Qin Qing Chapter 26 When did you come back?
